name: cloudField
notes: Instanced camera-facing puffs (InstancedBufferGeometry, 1 draw). Instance data in a float texture sorted far-first; shader wraps clusters along -Z (window 3200 m, fade-in 700 m, near fade 70 m) and re-seeds side/offset per wrap; draw order = rotated instance index via one int uniform (back-to-front stays correct, zero per-frame allocation). Puff atlas 1024^2 baked once on CPU (normals + top-lit AO + density). Clear corridor |x|<corridorX, |y|<25 m.
